encode_t5_prompt_embeds: encode text prompts into T5 text encoder hidden state embeddings for video generation
encode_clip_image_features: encode a PIL image into CLIP vision model embeddings for video generation conditioning
encode_vae_video_latents: encode a video tensor into normalized VAE latent representations with mean/std scaling
run_wan_text_encoder_step: run the WanTextEncoderStep modular pipeline block to generate prompt and negative prompt embeddings
run_wan_vae_encoder_step: run the WanVaeEncoderStep modular pipeline block to encode first frame image into masked condition latents
